Q: Map Over Elements of a List with Successive Elements from Another List A:

Sorry if my description was unclear. Your idea is a good one; here's an imperative language version of what I'm trying to do:

firstL = [[1,2], [3,4], ...]
secondL = [[2,3], [4,5], ...]

function mapper(firstL, secondL)
    for i in first
        LsecondL = map(x->someFunc(i,x), secondL)
    end
    return secondL
end

I know how to map a function using the first element of firstL over secondL; what I'm struggling with is how to do that with the rest of the elements of firstL and get back a secondL reflecting the result of all those mappings. It's easy in Julia because secondL is mutable.

Thanks for your help.

Q: Extract application database from android device through adb A:

Databases are stored in files, mostly on internal storage, in App's data directory like :

/data/data/com.example.myapp/mydb

so you can do

adb pull /data/data/com.example.myapp/mydb

Then you can use some software to open that file, and work with data base. To place it back:

adb push <new file> /data/data/com.example.myapp/mydb

Q: Recommendation for reading single cells using the readxl package in R A:

Packages {openxlsx} and {openxlsx2} both have ways to ignore column headers (example: openxlsx::readWorkbook(..., colNames = FALSE) but might be over the top, feature-wise, if you only need import functionality.

Q: Is it better to return `undefined` or `null` from a javascript function? A:

From the other responses we know undefined shouldn't be explicitly used and we should use null to express the absence of an object.

However, I still prefer to return undefined for two main reasons:

  • typeof null === 'object', which might cause some pretty nasty surprise if the client is using typeof myObj === 'object' to assert if a object value is present.

  • When using Typescript, adding the ? to type definition implicitly converts the type to T | undefined. When returning null to such a type, Typescript complains and we need to define as myField?: T | null, while myField?: T is shorter and, in practice, represents the same: "this value is optional". I prefer to keep consice and not use null then.

Q: Xcode 16 No launch screen or can't setup LaunchScreen A:

In case if you setup the storyboard name correctly (without extension) and the launch screen still doesn't appear, consult TN3118: Debugging your app’s launch screen. In my case I forgot to put checkmark next to "Is Initial View Controller".
